description: This file defines classes and methods for managing note properties and context menu interactions in the Notesnook project, including toggling states, editing dates, exporting content, and adding notebooks.

classes.name: BaseProperties
classes.description: Abstract class providing common functionality for note property toggles such as pin, lock, favorite, and archive.

classes.name: NotePropertiesModel
classes.description: Class for managing note properties like color, readonly state, and creation date.

classes.name: NoteContextMenuModel
classes.description: Class for handling context menu actions on notes, including color changes, exporting, moving to trash, and adding to notebooks.

methods.name: isPinned
methods.description: Checks if the note is pinned.

methods.name: pin
methods.description: Pins the note.

methods.name: unpin
methods.description: Unpins the note.

methods.name: lock
methods.description: Locks the note with a password.

methods.name: unlock
methods.description: Unlocks the note with a password.

methods.name: isLocked
methods.description: Checks if the note is locked.

methods.name: isFavorited
methods.description: Checks if the note is marked as favorite.

methods.name: favorite
methods.description: Marks the note as favorite.

methods.name: unfavorite
methods.description: Removes the favorite mark from the note.

methods.name: isArchived
methods.description: Checks if the note is archived.

methods.name: archive
methods.description: Archives the note.

methods.name: unarchive
methods.description: Unarchives the note.

methods.name: isColored
methods.description: Checks if the note has a specific color.

methods.name: color
methods.description: Sets the color of the note.

methods.name: isReadonly
methods.description: Checks if the note is readonly.

methods.name: readonly
methods.description: Sets the note to readonly.

methods.name: editable
methods.description: Sets the note to editable.

methods.name: getSessionHistory
methods.description: Retrieves the session history of the note.

methods.name: getDateCreated
methods.description: Gets the creation date of the note.

methods.name: editDateCreated
methods.description: Edits the creation date of the note.

methods.name: openInNewTab
methods.description: Opens the note in a new browser tab.

methods.name: moveToTrash
methods.description: Moves the note to trash.

methods.name: export
methods.description: Exports the note content in specified format.

methods.name: addToNotebook
methods.description: Adds the note to a specified notebook, including sub-notebooks.

methods.name: open
methods.description: Opens the context menu.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes the context menu.

methods.name: title
methods.description: Returns the title of the context menu.
